note: Geometry changed from ring to line because direction is not a transferable quantity when the population spans the ring. See prediction.md section 1.

geometry.route_count_rationale: 64 caused window clipping at the right edge once agents spread to r*+55; clipping is position-dependent bias. Window width and cost distribution unchanged.

initialization.M_rationale: calibrated on solitary only; regret 0.1829, stumble-onto-r* 5.5%. Declared calibration, not a treatment peek.
invariants: every agent position > r*  =>  all directions are -1  =>  direction is transferable
informed window contains r* at t=0
uninformed window excludes r* at t=0

direction.uninformed_target: argmin cost over own visible window

naive_gossip.rule: copy best_route of one uniformly random neighbor; move via sign(target - position); copied route only steers, never executed outside window

global_regret.reference: global optimum r*, NOT per-agent visible optimum

codec.known_asymmetry: equal payload, unequal information content: gossip 7 bits vs couzin log2(3)=1.58 bits. Recorded, not corrected.

admission.abort_means: treatment arms not executed, no verdict produced

gate.primary: upper bound of 95% CI of paired(couzin - gossip) < 0 in at least 2 adjacent informed_fraction cells at the same N
gate.scale_prediction: the smallest passing informed_fraction is non-increasing in N
gate.on_total_fail: record as negative result; do not adjust thresholds; do not rerun
